race.comment: HI FRANK (9) brings the right recent profile after being beaten a neck by Life Of Tree in a BM50 over 1400m at Chinchilla, where he was near the top of an open market and only just got run down late. Looks to be beautifully placed here and he can get the job done. JAMACRI (5) was dominant in a BM55 at Clermont, beating Boom Crusher in a dominant win, and the quick back-up keeps her in play. This is tougher, but she handled them with ease last start and she can play a leading role. BACCARAT ROUGE (2) has been poor at Doomben and Ipswich, but the drop from Saturday BM72 grade is significant and her 12-month profile remains the strongest counterpoint. SPIRIT OF NURAI (6) is not to be discounted.
